column1: # Design skill library manifest. Consumed by bin/design-skills-sync.
# Tab-separated: repo <TAB> ref <TAB> from <TAB> to <TAB> excludes
# `excludes` is a comma-separated list of gitignore-style patterns relative to the
# repo root. They are applied to the sparse fetch, so excluded blobs never download.
# Everything upstream is MIT. bin/design-skills-sync copies each LICENSE into licenses/.
